card.fact_statement: Firefighters had to cut open the rear of the bus after the 2025 Gerik bus crash.
card.source_span: Firefighters had to cut open the rear of the bus to extricate trapped victims.

target_qa_variants.question: ما هو التدخل المادي الذي اضطر رجال الإطفاء للقيام به في الحافلة بعد حادث حافلة جيريك عام 2025؟
target_qa_variants.source_span: Firefighters had to cut open the rear of the bus to extricate trapped victims.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'physical intervention' to 'التدخل المادي' and 'cut open the rear' to 'قطع الجزء الخلفي وفتحه'.
